settings.s3: We base our scents on life’s stories and narratives.
settings.s4: Inspire us with yours, and write to us with as much or as little as you wish. A moment in time, an experience, an excerpt to a longer chapter. Those which we can capture into a scent, we will.

settings.s2: A fine fragrance tells a story in a whisper, beckoning a listener to come closer.
settings.s3: We catch wind of it indirectly: in stolen moments, chance encounters, strokes of serendipity. These side stories stimulate our senses and tease our imaginations. They are the prologues to adventures, romances, and life’s little stories. They seduce and enchant, captivate and embolden, promising something not soon forgotten.

settings.s4: No more than 500 words. A moment, not a memoir — where you were, who was there, what the air was doing.
settings.s7: Every submission is read by the house. You will hear from us either way, within a month.
settings.s10: Four stories a year are sent to Jacques Chabert and the Argeville noses to be read aloud, unattributed.
settings.s13: Published under your name in the printed edition, with the first bottle of the run sent to you.

settings.s6: Someone here will read it — a person, not a filter — and you will hear from us within the month, whichever way it goes. Thank you for trusting us with it.
settings.s8: Air, weather, rooms, hands, hours. The specific over the sweeping — one Tuesday beats a whole decade.
settings.s10: Product reviews, note lists, or anything you would call content. Write it as though no one is buying.

settings.s4: Every fragrance on the shelf began this way — a story first, produced later.
settings.s7: “The bar was the kind of place Hemingway might have lingered a little too long.”
settings.s10: “The music was the same. The cool, oaky air of the church was the same.”
settings.s13: “There was such familiarity between them, as if they’d known each other a lifetime ago and were simply catching up.”

settings.s1: The small print, in plain English
settings.s3: You keep the copyright to everything you send. Always.
settings.s5: Nothing appears on this site, in a box, or in a bottle without your written yes.
settings.s7: You do not need to have bought anything. Open to anyone over 18.
settings.s9: You are credited by name in the printed edition, sent the first bottle of the run, and paid a commission fee agreed with you beforehand.
